title: HTTPS function calls
summary: Side-effect-free handlers share a 25-second read budget inside the 30-second HTTPS attempt, and retry once inside it when their database connection drops. Expiry returns read_deadline_exceeded with a narrower-read recovery and Performance failure evidence. A response timeout is reported once and never resent, because the server may still be running the call; only failures that never reached the server retry. A second connection drop, or a drop in a state-changing function, returns control_plane_connection_lost with a re-read-then-rerun recovery; any other handler exception answers handler_exception on in-process and HTTPS dispatch alike.
